criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 13 November 2027 (12 months after the 13 November 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $1,600,000 (2 x ($4,800,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $10,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $1,200,000 is wrong.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies that the Marlow Industries Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Lists the Marlow Industries Ltd change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $1,600,000 and the Seller's $1,200,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
